title: Velocity at tightening
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the speed when the harness begins to tighten, using energy conservation or kinematics (v = sqrt(2gL) = 10 m/s).

title: Total fall time
description: Important: Identifies the total time gravity acts as the sum of free-fall time (t0 = v/g) and the tightening time (t).

title: Gravitational impulse magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly computes the impulse due to gravity as I = mg(t + t0) = 1200 N·s.

title: Impulse-momentum application
description: Important: Applies the impulse-momentum theorem to relate the net impulse to the change in momentum during the tightening phase.

title: Average force calculation
description: Essential: Correctly determines the average impulsive force on the belt using F = I / t = 1200 N, where I is the impulse from tension.

title: Force pair recognition
description: Optional: Notes that the average force on the belt equals the average tension force on the worker by Newton's third law.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Misinterprets impulse or force as a scalar without consistent sign convention for direction.

title: Incorrect time interval
description: Pitfall: Uses only the tightening time (t) for the gravitational impulse, omitting the free-fall time.
